title: Schedule B to the Wayfare Driver Agreements: Required Documents, Inspection Interval, Expiry Notices and Document Holds
content:
For the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, each Wayfare service level lists the documents that must be on file and unexpired, how long a vehicle inspection stays valid, when expiry notices go out, and how a document hold behaves. Every level appears in the table below.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required documents | driver's license, auto insurance, vehicle inspection, vehicle registration | driver's license, auto insurance, vehicle inspection, vehicle registration | driver's license, auto insurance, vehicle inspection, vehicle registration | driver's license, auto insurance, vehicle inspection, vehicle registration | driver's license, auto insurance, vehicle inspection, vehicle registration, for-hire (commercial) permit | driver's license, auto insurance, vehicle inspection, vehicle registration, for-hire (commercial) permit |
| Inspection interval (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 6 | 6 |
| First expiry notice (days before expiry) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Second expiry notice (days before expiry) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Hold the day after a required document expires (the clause this setting serves is no longer in force) | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Document hold length before document-lapse deactivation (days) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Reversal of a document-lapse deactivation | reinstated once valid documents are on file | reinstated once valid documents are on file | reinstated once valid documents are on file | reinstated once valid documents are on file | reinstated once valid documents are on file | reinstated once valid documents are on file |

## What each line means

- **Required documents**: the documents that must be on file and unexpired for the level. Only the two Black levels require the for-hire permit.
- **Inspection interval**: the months a vehicle inspection stays valid from the inspection date.
- **Expiry notices**: the first notice is sent 30 calendar days and the second 7 calendar days before a document's expiry date.
- **Hold on expiry**: whether the agreement goes on hold the day after a required document expires; the schedule records "yes" on every level. The clause this setting serves, under which the agreement goes on hold for an expired document on the day after a required document expires without an unexpired replacement on file, is **no longer in force**: it has been superseded by the current basis. The setting is listed only as the schedule records it, and does not by itself place a hold.
- **Document hold length**: the calendar days a document hold may last before the agreement is deactivated for document lapse, 90 days on every level. This is the standard document hold length of the agreement's level. The clause under which a document hold still in place this many days after its hold start date ends in deactivation for document lapse is **no longer in force**: it has been superseded by the current basis. The figure itself remains the standard document hold length of the level.
- **Reversal**: a document-lapse deactivation is reversed without appeal once every required document is on file and unexpired.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A hypothetical auto insurance policy expiring on 2026-09-30 draws its first expiry notice on 2026-08-31 (30 days before) and its second on 2026-09-23 (7 days before). A hypothetical inspection passed on 2026-01-15 on the Wayfare Black level has a 6-month interval; on the Wayfare Standard level the interval is 12 months.
